name: io.github.drgost1/tufan-blox-bridge

description: Roblox Studio MCP server and plugin: 85 tools, snapshots, git, two-way sync, backdoor scanner.

environmentVariables.name: TUFAN_PROJECT

environmentVariables.name: TUFAN_OPENCLOUD_KEY

environmentVariables.name: TUFAN_MESHY_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Meshy AI API key for AI 3D-asset generation.
